items.name: 侧边快速提问
items.author: Volta-ln
items.description: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧的悬浮面板中，就当前话题提出小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，不写入、不影响主对话。支持流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，并自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。
items.descriptionEn: A floating side panel on the right edge of the DSH Web chat view that answers small questions about the current topic in an independent lightweight session driven through the official /api RPC, leaving the main conversation untouched. Streaming text, collapsible reasoning, tool chips, stop button, agent-preset selector, and an automatic context snapshot from the visible main chat.

items.name: Data Agent
items.author: omdsh-dev
items.description: 为 DSH 定义专用 Data Agent 预设，让 AI 帮你查询、更新、分析数据。
items.descriptionEn: Defines a dedicated Data Agent preset for DSH so the AI can query, update and analyze data.

items.name: dsh-TUI
items.author: ccch1mneyyy
items.description: Claude Code 风格全屏交互终端插件：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开、双击 Esc 回滚、上下文进度条与 TPS 仪表。
items.descriptionEn: A Claude Code style fullscreen interactive terminal plugin: pixel-whale header, live working-state line, streaming reasoning expansion, double-Esc rollback, context progress bar and TPS gauges.

items.name: 天书 TUI
items.author: huiliyi37
items.description: 基于官方 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式终端 UI 插件，在官方基础上增加 TDD 与证据门等工作流。
items.descriptionEn: An interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds TDD and evidence-gate workflows on top of the official base.

items.name: 上下文可视化
items.author: bowenliang123
items.description: 一站式 DeepSeek Harness 上下文洞察与可视化插件：Context 面板与浏览器加 /context 命令，透视上下文构成、历史演进与压缩/剪枝等事件，并展示消息与图片的 token 占用。
items.descriptionEn: A one-stop DeepSeek Harness context insight and visualization plugin: a Context dashboard and browser plus /context command that reveal composition, history evolution, compaction/prune events, and token cost per message and image.

items.name: 内置能力检查器
items.author: Starfie1d1272
items.description: Evidence-backed 内置 capability Inspector：展示 DSH Web built-in capability 的 provenance、compatibility 与 structural drift；仅对 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaves 提供 fail-closed 开关。
items.descriptionEn: Evidence-backed built-in capability Inspector: surfaces provenance, compatibility and structural drift of DSH Web built-ins, with fail-closed toggles for only the nine reviewed UI leaves.

items.name: Pilot 浏览器驾驶舱
items.author: guo6x
items.description: 给 agent 一双会开车的手：零依赖 CDP 浏览器操控（8 个 pilot_* 工具：导航/点击/输入/按键/JS/截图）+ Web GUI 可拖拽驾驶舱面板，无需 Playwright、无需 API key。
items.descriptionEn: Give your agent hands: zero-dependency CDP browser control (8 pilot_* tools: navigate/click/type/keys/eval/screenshot) plus a draggable cockpit panel in the Web GUI - no Playwright, no API key.

items.name: 环境管家
items.author: guo6x
items.description: 管住 agent 的脏手：工具链台账（node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg 等自动探测）、缓存与临时目录扫描 + 白名单安全一键清理、机器规则 AGENTS.md 查看编辑，全在设置面板完成。
items.descriptionEn: Keep your agent's hands clean: toolchain inventory, scratch/cache scan with whitelist-guarded one-click cleanup, and the machine rules file (AGENTS.md) view/edit - all in the settings panel.

items.name: DeepRead 精读助手
items.author: xiehuan123
items.description: 五种模式精读插件（quick / deep / map / feynman / book），支持公众号链接与文件输入、批量对比、预算预检与后台任务进度透明，导出 md / mm / html，Web UI 提供工具结果卡片与精读面板。
items.descriptionEn: A five-mode deep reading plugin (quick / deep / map / feynman / book) for links and files, with batch comparison, budget preflight, transparent background-job progress, md / mm / html exports, and Web UI tool-result cards plus a reading panel.

items.name: Mnemon 记忆系统
items.author: omdsh-dev
items.description: 与 Mnemon CLI 集成的跨 Agent、本地优先持久记忆插件：用户画像 / 工作记忆 / 项目档案与长期 Memory Spaces，支持导入导出。
items.descriptionEn: A cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin integrating the Mnemon CLI: profiles, working memory, project documents and long-term Memory Spaces, with import and export.

items.name: 插件门控中心
items.author: Noob-stupid
items.description: DSH 框架升级安全与插件升级门控：升级前契约预检 + 配置备份 + 整树回滚点，失败自动回滚、可一键回上一版，加载不了的插件有确证证据才自动禁用。安装与更新按候选插件的 dsh.engines 与 @deepseek-ai/* 范围门控，非 registry 来源可真装（registry 解析不了时回落 link: 开发式安装）。另带内置多源插件市场作发现层。
items.descriptionEn: Framework-upgrade safety and plugin-version gating for DSH: a contract pre-check, config backup and full-tree rollback point before an upgrade; a failed upgrade auto-rolls back, one click returns to the previous version, and a plugin the new framework cannot load is auto-disabled only on hard evidence. Installs and updates are gated by the candidate's dsh.engines and @deepseek-ai/* ranges; non-registry sources are really installed (falling back to a link: development install when the registry cannot resolve them). Ships a built-in multi-source plugin market as the discovery layer.

items.name: GenUI 生成式 UI
items.author: omdsh-dev
items.description: 给模型输出配交互式 UI：助手回复内联渲染 dsh-ui 围栏（布局、图表、表格、表单、Mermaid、3D、原生音视频），双通道渲染兼容原版 DSH 与新构建，支持流式渲染、面板停靠与组件交互回传模型。
items.descriptionEn: Interactive UI inside assistant replies via the dsh-ui fence: layouts, charts, tables, forms, quizzes, Mermaid, 3D and native audio/video. Dual-channel rendering covers stock DSH and newer builds, with streaming render, panel docking and component actions that loop back to the model.

items.name: 选中批注
items.author: omdsh-dev
items.description: 选中助手文字即可批注，回车随消息发送；自己的气泡只显示问题与「批注 ×N」标签，模型按 Annotation N 逐条对照回复（悬浮芯片）；UI 与批注块跟随 DSH 语言切换 zh/en，Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 可直发纯批注，斜杠命令原样放行。
items.descriptionEn: Select text in an assistant reply to annotate it; annotations ride along with your next message, hidden in your own bubble behind an Annotations xN chip, and the model replies per Annotation N with hoverable chips. UI and annotation block follow the DSH locale (zh/en); Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends annotations alone; slash commands pass through.

items.name: DeepSeek Harness Auth
items.author: taichuy
items.description: 为 DSH Web 公网部署提供登录认证前置代理，支持账号密码、验证码、失败锁定和 IP/CIDR 白名单。
items.descriptionEn: An authentication proxy for public DSH Web deployments with password login, captcha, failed-attempt locking, and IP/CIDR allowlists.

items.name: 云同步服务
items.author: dickpy
items.description: 支持 WebDAV、S3、阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS 与 MinIO 的 DSH 云同步插件，可同步 profile、插件配置及本地插件源码归档。
items.descriptionEn: DSH cloud sync for WebDAV, S3, Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent Cloud COS and MinIO, syncing profiles, plugin settings and local plugin source archives.

items.name: 自动记忆
items.author: Aik358
items.description: 主动联想记忆插件：记忆不靠模型调用，自己被唤回——Host 观察情境，NLP 关键词+向量化双轨检索，固定边界注入不破坏前缀缓存。三层记忆自动沉淀、欢迎向导（每项功能当场开关）、唤起回顾、无人值守、AI 问候与每日反思、日历、跨工具记忆继承。语义后端可自选：内置 JS 档（e5-small，默认）或可选 Python BGE-M3 int8，词法 BM25 永远兜底。
items.descriptionEn: Proactive associative memory: memories recall themselves without the model ever calling a tool. Host watches the conversation, dual-track retrieval (NLP keywords + vector similarity), fixed-boundary injection, prefix-cache friendly. Three-layer auto-consolidation, welcome tour with per-feature switches, recall review, unattended mode, AI greetings & reflections, calendar, cross-tool memory inheritance. Semantic backends selectable: built-in JS tier (e5-small, default) or optional Python BGE-M3 int8 — lexical BM25 always-on as 0GB floor.

items.name: 项目记忆 Memoir
items.author: Qinling-Melon-Farmers
items.description: 项目持久化记忆与会话经验沉淀：memoir_record / memoir_read 工具（BM25 相关度排序检索）、每轮工作自动蒸馏、记忆诊断面板与跨项目全局检索，纯本地零外部依赖。
items.descriptionEn: Project persistent memory and session-lessons distillation: memoir_record / memoir_read tools with BM25-ranked retrieval, per-turn auto-distill, a memory diagnostics panel and cross-project search - fully local, no external dependency.

items.name: 牛马修仙看板
items.author: spacexun2
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 工时统计 × 修仙养成：日/周/月/学年四档汇总 agent 活跃时长、token、输入与工具调用，十二重境界（炼气→宇宙洪荒）量化进度，纯本地存储。
items.descriptionEn: Worktime statistics meets cultivation: daily / weekly / monthly / yearly agent activity, token, input and tool-call summaries with a twelve-realm progression (Qi Refining to Cosmic Chaos), fully local.

items.name: 技能中心（Skill Explorer）
items.author: wingsky-1
items.description: DSH 技能中心：按来源分级浏览已加载 skill（系统内置 / 项目 / 用户 / 自定义 / 运行时），支持启用/禁用、创建与删除（移入 .trash）。
items.descriptionEn: DSH skill center: browse loaded skills grouped by source (bundled / project / user / custom / runtime), with enable/disable, create and delete (move to .trash).

items.name: 过程精简 Friendly Steps
items.author: dongwenxiu83-web
items.description: 面向文字工作者的过程精简：纯 CSS 折叠 Think / 工具调用等技术过程行，右下角浮条「已完成 N 步」一键展开收起，失败步骤红色计数反馈；不注入 React 列表、无全量扫描，零侵入。
items.descriptionEn: Writer-friendly process collapse: hides Think / tool-call rows via pure CSS behind a floating 'N steps done' pill with red failure counts and one-click expand/collapse. No foreign nodes in React lists, no full-DOM scans — zero interference.

items.name: 全功能远程访问
items.author: JUANWANG-BUAA
items.description: 令牌门控反向代理：公网隧道或局域网下，在手机等设备上远程使用 DeepSeek Harness，设置、凭据与文件访问保持可用，支持按设备会话。
items.descriptionEn: Token-gated reverse proxy for remote access: use DeepSeek Harness over public tunnels or LAN from phones and other devices, with settings, credentials and file access kept working and per-device sessions.

items.name: 历史树
items.author: z953218350
items.description: 在聊天消息左侧提供 Codex 风格对话轮次时间线点阵与悬浮历史概览卡片，支持鱼眼放大动效与点击直达对应轮次。
items.descriptionEn: Codex-style conversation turn timeline rail and hover overview cards beside chat messages, with fish-eye magnification and click-to-jump navigation.

items.name: dsh-gzip
items.author: wingsky-1
items.description: /api 响应 gzip 压缩插件：为远程 / 低带宽链路开启 /api 响应压缩，解决会话历史因大响应无压缩而超时加载失败的问题；SSE / zip / 已编码响应自动豁免，无全局副作用。
items.descriptionEn: API response gzip plugin for DSH Web GUI: enables gzip on /api responses for remote / low-bandwidth links, fixing session-history loads that fail on the timeout of large uncompressed responses; SSE, zip and already-encoded responses are passed through untouched, with no global side effects.

items.name: WSL Windows 桥
items.author: ch1bug
items.description: 让 WSL 里的 agent 访问 Windows 侧：读写 C:\ 文件、运行 .exe、Explorer 打开、wslpath 路径互转与盘符枚举（win_ls/read/write/run/open/path/drives）。
items.descriptionEn: Lets a WSL agent reach the Windows host: read/write C:\ files, run .exe programs, open in Explorer, convert paths via wslpath and list drives (win_ls/read/write/run/open/path/drives).

items.name: MiMo 多模态工具
items.author: ch1bug
items.description: 把小米 MiMo API 封装为 agent 工具：联网搜索、图像/音频/视频理解、语音转写、语音合成与音色克隆（mimo_search/vision/audio/video/asr/tts/voiceclone）。
items.descriptionEn: Turns the Xiaomi MiMo API into agent tools: web search, image/audio/video understanding, speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice cloning (mimo_search/vision/audio/video/asr/tts/voiceclone).

items.name: 技能模糊搜索
items.author: ch1bug
items.description: Codex 风格模糊技能搜索：/bug、/diag、/regression 都能在 / 技能菜单里命中 diagnosing-bugs（名称子序列 + 描述连续子串匹配）。
items.descriptionEn: Codex-style fuzzy skill search: /bug, /diag and /regression all find diagnosing-bugs in the / skill menu (name subsequence + description substring matching).

items.name: 自动审批审核
items.author: DamonKoy
items.description: 只读工具自动放行、危险命令自动拒绝，可配置全自动模式。
items.descriptionEn: Auto-approves read-only tools, auto-denies dangerous commands, optional full-auto mode.

items.name: 项目记忆
items.author: DamonKoy
items.description: 按项目作用域持久化的键值记忆，支持增删查列与搜索。
items.descriptionEn: Project-scoped persistent key-value memories with set/get/list/delete/search.

items.name: dsh-notifier
items.author: wingsky-1
items.description: 审批/完成/错误事件通知：浏览器 Notification + 系统原生 toast（Windows PowerShell WinRT / Linux·macOS notify-send，零依赖）；提示音可配、错误同类合并、免打扰时段、通知历史与配置面板；非安全上下文自动降级横幅。
items.descriptionEn: Approval / completion / error event notifications: browser Notification API plus native OS toasts (Windows PowerShell WinRT, Linux and macOS notify-send, zero dependencies); configurable sound, error merging, quiet hours, notification history and a settings panel; falls back to in-page banners outside secure contexts.

items.name: 逻辑探针
items.author: AmethystLuna
items.description: AI 智能体声明核查技能：枚举设计文档与重构计划中的每个可验证声明，对照代码库事实逐条核验；行为类声明升级为状态机/数据模型逻辑原语验证，支持前后回归、领域约束与并发风险挖掘，输出 file:line 证据。
items.descriptionEn: Claim verification for AI coding agents: enumerate every verifiable claim in design docs and refactoring plans, verify against codebase facts, then escalate behavioral claims to state-machine/data-model logic-primitive verification with before/after regression, domain constraints, and concurrency risk mining.

items.name: 订阅管理
items.author: Aa728848
items.description: 让 DSH 用上你已订阅的模型：ChatGPT、Kimi、Claude、Command Code、WorkBuddy、MiniMax Code、Google Antigravity 七条线路各自独立登录、独立额度卡片；支持 PKCE OAuth 与设备码登录、DPAPI/钥匙串/0600 凭据存储、流式 Responses、图片生成、Codex 搜索与子代理模型授权。
items.descriptionEn: Bring the model subscriptions you already pay for into DSH: seven independent lines (ChatGPT, Kimi, Claude, Command Code, WorkBuddy, MiniMax Code, Google Antigravity), each with its own login and quota card; PKCE OAuth and device-code login, DPAPI/keychain/0600 credential storage, streaming Responses, image generation, Codex search and subagent model authorization.

items.name: AI 生图
items.author: dickpy
items.description: AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供生成历史、提示词模板库与 API 设置卡片。
items.descriptionEn: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with generation history, a prompt template library and an API settings card.

items.name: 接口捕获
items.author: lemonmmice
items.description: Fiddler 式实时抓包面板：tail 客户端 System.Net 跟踪日志自动解析 HTTP 请求/响应（gzip 自动解包）并实时入库，内置本地 MITM 代理可抓任意进程，支持筛选 / 详情 / 导出 / 重放 / 标记。
items.descriptionEn: Fiddler-style realtime capture panel: tails the client's System.Net trace log into live HTTP request/response records (gzip auto-decompressed), plus a built-in local MITM proxy for arbitrary processes, with filters, detail view, export, replay and flags.

items.name: 接口调试
items.author: lemonmmice
items.description: 类 Postman 接口调试面板：由宿主服务端发起 HTTP 请求（绕过浏览器 CORS），支持 WebSocket / 原始 TCP / gRPC、鉴权助手、环境变量、cURL 导入导出、请求集合与历史。
items.descriptionEn: Postman-style API debug panel: host-side HTTP requests without browser CORS limits, plus WebSocket / raw TCP / gRPC, auth helpers, env variables, cURL import/export, request collections and history.

items.name: 企业信息查询 Agent
items.author: liaoyonghong
items.description: 把企业文档变成可对话的聊天机器人：员工或应用系统用自然语言提问，AI 代理查阅文档后带出处回答；同时提供 workspace 内容 HTTP API。
items.descriptionEn: Turn enterprise documents into a conversational Q&A bot: employees or apps ask in natural language and an AI agent answers with cited sources; also exposes a workspace content HTTP API.

items.name: LLM 裁判复核
items.author: Aa728848
items.description: DSH 原生可配置 LLM 裁判复核插件：成对比较、锦标赛择优、进度判定与自动验收门控（verifier_compare/select/track/current_session），A–T 标尺 + 期望评分，自带 Web 设置面板。
items.descriptionEn: Configurable DSH-native LLM verifier plugin: pairwise comparison, pivot tournament selection, progress tracking and auto-acceptance gating (verifier_compare/select/track/current_session) with A-T scale scoring and a Web settings page.

items.name: 会话 ID
items.author: yufengnigel
items.description: 侧边栏底部会话 ID 面板：列出全部会话的完整 ID 并一键复制（纯浏览器、只读，不修改会话状态）。
items.descriptionEn: Sidebar-foot Session ID panel: lists every session with its full id and one-click copy (browser-only and read-only, never mutates sessions).

items.name: 会话复盘
items.author: GreenLv
items.description: 回头看看你是怎么使用 AI 的：/session-insights 会整理一段时间内的 DSH 会话，找出哪些做法有效、哪些问题总在重复、最终真正留下了哪些成果，并生成一份保存在本机的复盘报告。
items.descriptionEn: See how you have been using AI: /session-insights reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.

items.name: MCP 管理器
items.author: wingsky-1
items.description: MCP 服务器管理插件：分工作目录维护项目级 / 全局两级 MCP 配置（项目级随仓库走、可提交 git），模型面经中间层恒定两个原子工具（ws_mcp_search / ws_mcp_call）按会话 cwd 路由、不同仓库互不串台；支持 stdio / streamable-http 双传输、JSON 导入与浮窗状态面板。
items.descriptionEn: MCP server management plugin: per-working-directory project/global config tiers (project-level travels with the repo, committable to git); the model surface stays at two middleware atomic tools (ws_mcp_search / ws_mcp_call) routed by session cwd, so different repos never clash; stdio / streamable-http transports, JSON import and a floating status panel.

items.name: 用量统计悬浮框
items.author: wingsky-1
items.description: 多 provider 通用用量统计框架：内置 DeepSeek 官方（余额 + 峰谷倒计时徽标 + 每日用量推算）与 OpenCode Go 开箱即用，自写一个 mjs 适配器文件即可接入任意数据源并在设置页热插拔；渲染在宿主端完成，密钥不进浏览器。
items.descriptionEn: A generic multi-provider usage statistics framework: DeepSeek official (balance + peak/valley countdown badge + daily usage estimation) and OpenCode Go adapters built in out of the box; plug in any data source with one mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page. Rendering happens host-side - keys never reach the browser.

items.name: 会话里程碑导航条
items.author: SnowCrescenter-tech
items.description: DSH Web UI 右侧的圆点时间轴：每条提问一个圆点，悬停查看内容与元信息（时间、轮次、耗时、TTFT、token），点击即跳转；附带全会话消息列表、站内与跨会话搜索、书签深链接（#msg=）和键盘导航。
items.descriptionEn: Git-style dot timeline on the right edge of the DSH web UI: one dot per user message, hover for content and metadata (time, turn, duration, TTFT, tokens), click to jump; full-session list, in-session and cross-session search, #msg= deep-link bookmarks, keyboard navigation.

items.name: 消息删除
items.author: viplocco
items.description: 每条消息操作区的垃圾桶按钮：确认后经官方 surface-replace 契约将消息从模型上下文移除并从转录隐藏，原始日志不动、随时可恢复；覆盖用户/助手/注入行/工具调用/Think 卡，失败回合整窗清理与步骤级删除，删除前预检置灰、过渡动画，中英双语界面。
items.descriptionEn: A trash icon in every message action bar: confirmed deletes remove the message from model context via the official surface-replace contract and hide it from the transcript, while raw logs stay intact and recoverable. Covers user/assistant/injected rows, tool calls and Think cards; whole-window cleanup of failed turns, step-level deletion, preflight graying, transition animations, bilingual zh/en UI.

items.name: Notion 集成
items.author: Zhiyi-Zhao
items.description: DSH Notion 技能：通过官方 REST API 读写 Notion 工作区——搜索/读取页面（转 markdown）、创建/更新页面、查询/新增/更新数据库条目；纯 Python 标准库、零依赖、Windows / macOS / Linux 通用。
items.descriptionEn: A DSH Notion skill: read and write your Notion workspace via the official REST API - search/read pages as markdown, create/update pages, query/add/update database entries; pure Python stdlib, zero dependencies, cross-platform.

items.name: 远程访问网关
items.author: slywalker2006
items.description: 为 DSH Web 公网部署增加登录与多租户控制的网关插件：自动 HTTPS、多账号权限/配额/沙箱、会话级访问控制、登录限流与审计日志、SQLite 静态加密（内置于 dsh web 前端，中英双语 UI）。
items.descriptionEn: Server-grade gateway that turns DeepSeek Harness into a multi-tenant platform: remote access + automatic HTTPS, per-subuser permissions and quotas, sandbox enforcement, first-run setup, SQLite auth with at-rest encryption, rate-limit and audit log (bilingual UI).

items.name: 免费搜索
items.author: DDDMUC
items.description: 无需 API key 的多引擎网络搜索：10 个引擎自动回退（Bing/DDG/AnySearch/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek 等——其中付费引擎需各自配置 API key）+ 时间过滤 + 8 个平台搜索 + Web 设置面板。安装时会接管宿主默认 web 搜索 provider（searchProvider=ddg 指向本插件），卸载时由 bundle patch 的 rollbackPatch 恢复原默认值。
items.descriptionEn: Multi-engine web search without API keys: 10 engines with auto-fallback (Bing/DDG/AnySearch/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek — paid engines need their own API key) + time filtering + 8 platform searches + a web settings panel. Installing takes over the host default web search provider (searchProvider=ddg points at this plugin); uninstalling restores the previous default via the bundle patch rollbackPatch.

items.name: Agent Plugins市场（兼容Claude Code Plugin）
items.author: Sivan757
items.description: 把 Claude Code 插件市场生态接入 DSH：任意 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Kimi 市场 git 仓库加为源，即可一键安装 suite，skills、MCP 服务器、hooks 与斜杠命令在运行时注入会话；Web GUI 内置市场页面，零转换零拷贝，Claude Code 技能原样可用。
items.descriptionEn: Brings the Claude Code plugin-marketplace ecosystem into DSH: add any Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Kimi marketplace git repo as a source and install suites with one click - skills, MCP servers, hooks and slash commands are injected into sessions at runtime, with a market page right inside the Web GUI; zero conversion, zero copying, Claude Code skills work verbatim.

items.name: 全文搜索
items.author: termanli
items.description: 侧边栏按文件内容全文搜索当前会话工作目录（ripgrep 优先、纯 JS 引擎回退），支持正则、大小写与整词匹配，点击结果行在编辑器中打开文件。需先安装 dsh-better-sidebar（npm 包）；商店一键安装不会自动带上该依赖。
items.descriptionEn: Full-text content search over the session working directory in the sidebar (ripgrep-first with a pure-JS engine fallback), with regex, case and whole-word matching; click a result row to open the file in the editor. Requires dsh-better-sidebar (npm package); the store's one-click install does not pull it in.

items.name: 思考强度配置器
items.author: Jamsharden
items.description: 为第三方 API 的模型提供可视化思考强度配置：支持自定义 reasoning effort 档位、Provider 默认强度、思考协议与参数开关，让 DSH 用户使用第三方 API 时也能调节思考强度。基于 pi-ai 0.85.1 重新生成 961 条官方模型档位数据，其中 737 个支持 reasoning，覆盖 GPT-6 Astra、DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash、Kimi K3、GLM-5.3-Flash、Claude Opus 5 / Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.8 等模型；侧边栏入口样式与官方插件行对齐。兼容 DSH >=0.1.1-rc.2；DSH核验支持版本为 0.1.1-rc.2 与 0.1.2-alpha.1，插件在这两个版本下均可正常运行；卸载插件不会自动删除已写入 llm-pi-ai 的思考配置。
items.descriptionEn: Adds a visual reasoning-effort editor for models served by third-party APIs, with custom levels, provider defaults, thinking-format and parameter controls, so DSH users can tune thinking strength when using external endpoints. Regenerated from pi-ai 0.85.1 with 961 official model-level entries, including 737 with reasoning support, covering models such as GPT-6 Astra, DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3-Flash, Claude Opus 5 / Sonnet 5, and Gemini 3.8; the sidebar entry is aligned with the official plugin row styling. Compatible with DSH >=0.1.1-rc.2; DSH verified support versions are 0.1.1-rc.2 and 0.1.2-alpha.1, and the plugin runs normally on both versions; uninstalling does not automatically remove reasoning settings written to llm-pi-ai.

items.name: 码灵
items.author: Nath-Vikky
items.description: 把 DSH 使用事件转化为码灵遭遇、收集与战斗的 Web 游戏插件：包含 25 只码灵、五类计算属性、8×8 指令三消、三只编队共享运行值、阶段伤害与防护、Boss 机制、捕捉养成、挂机补给和无尽塔；状态保存在 DSH 主目录的 codekinsave/state.json，首次启动会无损迁移旧的 tracewild/state.json，卸载后默认保留，不修改提示词、工具或模型请求。
items.descriptionEn: A Web creature-collection RPG driven by DSH activity events, with 25 Codekin, five computing attributes, an 8×8 command-match battle system, shared squad runtime, phase damage and defense, Boss mechanics, capture, growth, idle supplies and an endless tower. State is stored in codekinsave/state.json under the DSH home directory; the former tracewild/state.json is migrated losslessly on first launch, and progress remains after uninstall by default. Prompts, tools and model requests are unchanged.

items.name: 归档管理
items.author: Ultronen
items.description: 管理已归档与未归档会话，支持搜索、预览、标签备注、工作区归档、ZIP 备份、选择操作、回收站恢复、空间与保留策略、来源分支和自动残留会话检查。
items.descriptionEn: Manage archived and unarchived chats with search, previews, tags and notes, workspace archiving, ZIP backups, selected actions, a Recycle Bin, storage and retention, origins and branches, and automatic residual chat checks.

items.name: 提示词增强
items.author: rongxingda
items.description: 输入框一键提示词增强：把草稿改写为结构化提示词（角色与目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边界条件），支持前后对比、回填与一键撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。
items.descriptionEn: One-click prompt enhancement in the composer: rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.

items.name: 完成守卫
items.author: GreenLv
items.description: 避免 DSH Agent 在长任务中忘记你的要求。会话恢复后继续核对关键条件和完成依据，防止只做完一部分就报告整个任务已完成。
items.descriptionEn: Keeps DSH agents from forgetting your requirements during long tasks. After a session resumes, it checks the key conditions and completion evidence again so partial work is not reported as the whole task done.

items.name: 会话增强（dsh-session-enhance）
items.author: Tinger-X
items.description: 会话管理增强插件：支持真实物理删除、跨工作区分组拖拽搬移会话、一键物理文件与 storages JSON 对账及墓碑防复活机制。
items.descriptionEn: Enhanced session management plugin: physical transcript deletion, cross-workspace drag-and-drop migration, physical file reconciliation, and tombstone anti-resurrection.

items.name: AI 音频
items.author: shimingming520
items.description: AI 音频生成插件：通过可配置的多厂商渠道（OpenAI 兼容、ElevenLabs、MiniMax、Stability AI 与自定义）实现 TTS 文本转语音、音乐与音效生成，提供按渠道模型/音色目录、Agent 工具与侧边栏面板。
items.descriptionEn: AI audio generation for the dsh web GUI: TTS, music and sound effects through configurable multi-vendor channels (OpenAI-compatible, ElevenLabs, MiniMax, Stability AI and custom), with per-channel model/voice catalogs, an Agent tool and a sidebar panel.

items.name: LinkDigest
items.author: jcaiagent7143-ui
items.description: 把小红书、抖音、TikTok、YouTube 或 X 链接转成文本：带时间戳的转写、屏幕文字、逐图描述与 OCR、正文与元数据。挂载托管的 MCP 服务，不需要本地浏览器和登录。
items.descriptionEn: Turns a Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, YouTube or X link into text: transcript with timecodes, on-screen text, a description and OCR of every image, caption and metadata. Mounts a hosted MCP server over streamable HTTP, with no local browser or login step.

items.name: 引用追问
items.author: tr1v3r
items.description: 在 Web 对话里划选任意文本，一键以原生引用 chip 追加进输入框进行针对性追问；发送时自动展开为模型可读的 Markdown 引文，旧宿主降级为纯文本引用。
items.descriptionEn: Select any text in the Web transcript and append it to the composer as a native quote chip for a targeted follow-up; chips expand into model-readable Markdown quotes on send, with a plain-text fallback on older hosts.

items.name: Effort Slider
items.author: mrSutivu
items.description: 输入框内的模型选择与推理强度滑杆二合一胶囊：带刻度拖拽、最高档流光动画，跟随主题变量，中英法三语。
items.descriptionEn: Model picker and reasoning-effort slider in one composer pill: notched drag, max-effort shimmer, theme variables, English, French and Chinese labels.

items.name: 一键备份与恢复
items.author: xiaoyuyu6420
items.description: 一键备份与恢复 DSH 用户数据：定时自动备份（重启续跑）、每日/每周分级保留、分类型备份与 merge 恢复；sha256 校验与加固恢复（拒路径穿越/软链，失败自动回滚）；/backup doctor 从已知良好备份体检并定点修复会话日志；宿主起不来也能用的进程外救援台；升级前自动快照、损坏会话先隔离再入档；凭据默认脱敏进本地保险库，跨机迁移列出需重填项。
items.descriptionEn: One-command backup and restore of DSH user data: scheduled auto-backup that survives restarts, daily/weekly tiered retention, per-type backup with merge restore; sha256 verification and hardened restore (path-traversal and symlink rejection, auto-rollback on failure); /backup doctor scans and repairs session logs from a known-good backup; an out-of-process rescue console that works even when the host will not boot; pre-upgrade snapshots and quarantine of corrupt session logs; credentials redacted into a local vault by default with a re-entry checklist for cross-machine moves.

items.name: 任务折叠
items.author: yindf
items.description: 把已完成的 agent 工作折叠成一条带标题的简短摘要，长会话保持可读、请求更省；每次折叠的原始内容随时可用 fold_recall 原样读回。
items.descriptionEn: Folds finished agent work into a short titled summary so long sessions stay readable and requests stay cheap; every fold's original content can be read back verbatim on demand.

items.name: AI 自动复核
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 审批的第二模型 AI 自动复核：一个只读审查子代理在审批应答链上给出允许/拒绝裁决，默认失败关闭，并记录完整会话日志供审计回溯。
items.descriptionEn: Second-model AI auto-review for DeepSeek Harness approval requests: a read-only reviewer subagent decides allow/deny on the approval answerer chain, with fail-closed fallback and a full session-log audit.

items.name: 声明式权限规则
items.author: PerryLink
items.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格声明式权限规则与 Codex 风格进程级网络策略：按序 allow/deny/ask 规则匹配工具名、参数（glob/正则）、工作区路径与网络目标（域名/IP/端口/协议），内置本地 HTTP/CONNECT 代理管控 shell 子进程流量，三种网络模式映射官方沙箱预设，附会话日志审计、规则热重载与含规则编辑器的设置页。
items.descriptionEn: Declarative Claude Code-style permission rules plus a Codex-style process-level network policy for DeepSeek Harness: ordered allow/deny/ask rules matching tool names, arguments (glob/regex), workspace paths and network targets (domain/IP/port/scheme), a built-in local HTTP/CONNECT proxy governing shell subprocess traffic, three network modes mapped onto the official sandbox presets, full session-log audit, HMR rule reload, and a settings page with a rule editor.

items.name: 鲸鱼娘·灵动挂件
items.author: nickkkkkk123123
items.description: 会卖萌、会记账的 DSH 桌面挂件：实时余额与用量、上下文进度条、CPU/内存信息面板（独立窗口+物理跟随）、拖拽甩抛与碰撞反弹、子代理状态徽章、右键菜单与彩蛋。
items.descriptionEn: A lively DSH desktop widget: realtime balance & usage, context progress bar, CPU/RAM info panel (independent window with physics follow), drag-fling with collision bounce, subagent badges, context menu and easter eggs.

items.name: DSH 桌面外壳
items.author: RINGOLINK
items.description: 仅 Windows。把 DSH WebUI 变成本机桌面应用：预编译启动器（WebView2 独立窗口 + 托盘常驻，关闭窗口最小化到托盘，托盘右键才退出）。安装会在 %USERPROFILE%\dsh-desktop 写入 DSHLauncher.exe 与 WebView2 DLL，并创建桌面/开始菜单快捷方式；登录自启默认关闭，需要时在设置里开启。启动器未托管后端时，「重启后端」会对整个后端进程树执行 taskkill /T /F 强杀再按原参数拉起（会中断进行中的会话）。设置里提供安装/修复、重建快捷方式、登录自启开关、清理安装（删除上述文件与快捷方式）与重启。
items.descriptionEn: Windows only. Turns the DSH Web UI into a desktop app: a prebuilt launcher with its own WebView2 window and tray icon (closing the window hides it; only the tray menu exits and stops the backend). Installing writes DSHLauncher.exe and the WebView2 DLLs to %USERPROFILE%\dsh-desktop and creates desktop/start-menu shortcuts; sign-in autostart is off by default and can be enabled in the settings row. When no launcher manages the backend, restarting it force-kills the whole backend process tree (taskkill /T /F) and relaunches it with the original arguments, interrupting in-flight sessions. The settings row offers install/repair, shortcut rebuild, the autostart switch, removal (deletes those files and shortcuts) and restart.

items.name: 会话删除
items.author: DDDMUC
items.description: 在侧边栏会话菜单里直接删除会话：风险确认（可勾选不再询问）后真正删除会话日志、工作区记账与宿主内存状态；自动等待被占用会话的写所有权释放，中英双语，宿主路由仅限本机回环。
items.descriptionEn: Delete sessions straight from the sidebar session menu: a risk-consent dialog (with a dont-ask-again option) then a real delete of the log, workspace accounting and live state; waits out the write lease of an occupied session, bilingual, loopback-only host route.

items.name: 终端面板
items.author: hyzyn
items.description: 侧边栏「终端」大弹窗：xterm.js + PTY 全交互终端，多标签与断线自动重连，可选 tmux 会话持久化（宿主重启后恢复现场）；ssh2 原生 SSH 标签（agent forwarding、主机指纹 TOFU 钉扎），SFTP 上传下载与本地/远程端口转发隧道；agent 侧配套 tty_* / sftp_* / tunnel_* 工具。
items.descriptionEn: A full terminal panel in the sidebar: xterm.js with a real PTY, multiple tabs, automatic reconnect and optional tmux-backed session persistence that survives host restarts; native ssh2 SSH tabs with agent forwarding and TOFU host-key pinning, SFTP transfer, and local/remote port-forward tunnels, with matching tty_* / sftp_* / tunnel_* tools for the agent.

items.name: 容器面板
items.author: hyzyn
items.description: Docker 容器面板：本机或 SSH 目标上的容器列表（含 Compose 项目视图）、启停删、日志与统计实时跟随、事件活动条、镜像与网络/卷详情。默认只读，变更操作与 docker exec 需在设置里显式开启，agent 侧配套只读优先的 docker_* 工具。
items.descriptionEn: A Docker panel for local or SSH targets: container lists with a Compose project view, start/stop/remove, live log and stats streaming, an events feed, plus image, network and volume details. Read-only by default - mutations and docker exec need an explicit settings switch - with read-only-first docker_* tools for the agent.

items.name: 代码图谱
items.author: hyzyn
items.description: Codegraph 集成：在设置 → 插件里查看索引状态、搜索符号、查看 callers/callees/impact，一键增量 sync 或全量重建；自动托管 codegraph MCP 服务器行并把 cwd 对齐默认项目路径，模型可直接用 mcp__codegraph__* 查询代码。
items.descriptionEn: Codegraph integration: inspect index status, search symbols and walk callers/callees/impact from the settings card, with one-click incremental sync or full rebuild; manages the codegraph MCP server row and aligns its cwd with the default project so the model can query code through mcp__codegraph__*.

items.name: 环境变量与密钥管理
items.author: hyzyn
items.description: 图形化管理环境变量与密钥：托管 ~/.dsh/env.yml 的区块，支持普通值与 js: 前缀表达式，密钥明文默认存入官方凭据存储而 env 文件只留清单；保存后写入当前进程环境，供宿主与后续子进程使用。
items.descriptionEn: Graphical environment-variable and secret management: manages the managed block of ~/.dsh/env.yml with plain values and js: expression prefixes, keeps secret plaintext in the official credential store while the env file holds only the manifest, and applies changes to the running process for the host and later subprocesses.

items.name: MCP 服务器配置
items.author: hyzyn
items.description: 图形化 MCP 服务器配置中心：托管 ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml 的 MCP 区块，保存后经 HMR 热加载为 mcp__<server>__<tool> 工具、无需重启；支持 stdio 与 streamable-http 两种传输、js: 前缀的环境变量与请求头表达式、连接测试、启用停用与删除。
items.descriptionEn: A graphical MCP server config center: manages the MCP block of ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml and hot-loads it via HMR into mcp__<server>__<tool> tools without a restart; supports stdio and streamable-http transports, js: expression prefixes for env vars and headers, connection tests, enable/disable and delete.

items.name: Profile 管理
items.author: hyzyn
items.description: 可视化管理 DSH profile：查看、创建、复制、重命名、删除与端口配置。每个 profile 是 $DSH_HOME/profiles 下的独立目录，拥有自己的 bundle 层与补丁文件，多环境互不干扰。
items.descriptionEn: Visual DSH profile management: inspect, create, duplicate, rename, delete and configure ports. Each profile is a standalone directory under $DSH_HOME/profiles with its own bundle layers and patch files, so multiple environments never interfere.

items.name: Prompt 管理
items.author: hyzyn
items.description: systemPrompt 可视化管理：编辑、版本管理、A/B 测试与导出分享。配置保存在 ~/.dsh/prompts.yml 的托管区块，启用后作为 systemPrompt section 注入；A/B 开启时按比例随机命中版本。
items.descriptionEn: Visual systemPrompt management: editing, versioning, A/B testing and export/share. Config lives in the managed block of ~/.dsh/prompts.yml; the active prompt is injected as a systemPrompt section, and in A/B mode sessions are routed to a variant by weight.

items.name: 新闻聚合
items.author: hyzyn
items.description: RSS / 新闻聚合：订阅多个 RSS 与 Atom 源，每天自动汇总成一篇「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt 供模型直接引用；支持分类分组，订阅都在设置卡片里管理。
items.descriptionEn: RSS and news digest: subscribe to multiple RSS and Atom feeds and get a daily "today's worth reading" Markdown digest injected into the systemPrompt for the model to cite directly, with category grouping and all feed management in a settings card.

items.name: 全局搜索
items.author: hyzyn
items.description: 侧边栏「全局搜索」入口（⌘/Ctrl+K 也可唤出命令面板）：全文搜索历史会话、Prompt、MCP 工具与设置面板，一键跳转到命中的会话或设置项。
items.descriptionEn: A sidebar Global Search entry with a ⌘/Ctrl+K command palette: full-text search across past sessions, prompts, MCP tools and settings panels, jumping straight to the matching session or setting.

items.name: 推理后停滞续跑
items.author: 4evercool
items.description: 当回合以 completed（或 no-visible-output）结束、且最后一条助手消息只有推理内容、既没有文本也没有工具调用时，等待 graceMs 后通过 agent 注册表发送一条续跑消息。与 dsh-client-auto-continue 分工：不处理 error / interrupted / max-tokens；由 cooldownMs 与 maxConsecutive 限制连续续跑次数，用户消息或有可见输出的回合会重置计数。
items.descriptionEn: Resumes a turn that ends completed (or no-visible-output) when the last assistant message carried reasoning only, with no text and no tool call: after graceMs it sends one follow-up through the agent registry. Complements dsh-client-auto-continue and never touches error / interrupted / max-tokens; cooldownMs and maxConsecutive bound repeated resumes, and a user message or a turn with visible output resets the counter.

items.name: 会话线程工具
items.author: wig123
items.description: 把 Codex 的线程工具搬到 DSH 上：让模型列出你开着的那些会话、按正文检索它们、给某个正在跑的会话递消息并读回它的回答，还能新建空会话或从已有会话的已完成轮次分叉。
items.descriptionEn: Codex's thread tools on DSH: the model can list the sessions you have open, search their content, hand one of them a message and read the answer back, open a fresh session, or branch one from its completed turns.

items.name: 消耗统计面板
items.author: AlfredChaos

items.name: 工作台：迭代时间轴与技能库
items.author: liiydong
items.description: DSH Web 的「工作台」面板，把一个项目里「AI 改 Markdown → 生成 Word/PDF/Excel → 你审这一版」的过程变成一条看得见的时间轴，可停在主区域，也可停在右侧栏与对话并排（对话留在中间，两边对照着看）。① 迭代（默认）：按产线分组、产线内按天分小节、一轮一行，显示时间 / 产物类型 / 这一版干了什么 / 改自哪几个 md / 审批状态；鼠标悬停浮出摘要卡（摘要、产出时间与体积、生成命令、改动来源、快照路径、你的历史意见）；点开一轮可【通过】【要改】【重置为待审】，写进 .versions/decisions.jsonl。时间轴不是猜的：数据来自各产线目录下的 .versions/produced.jsonl，由产出方在产出那一刻写入；对「文件躺在目录里、记录里却没有」的产物，面板会列出来（未入记录），补一句说明即可收编成一版——复制一份快照到 .versions/ 并追加一行记录，同时从 DSH 会话日志里反推「最近一次生成它的命令」。看过之后可以直接【打开这一版】/【打开成品】/【在文件夹里】。② 和上一版比：把这一版和上一版的正文摆到一起，段落级 diff（新增标绿、删掉标红），配成对的改动段再按词高亮；Excel 一族按行分块、只把改了的那一格描出来，和 Word 用同一套 diff。③ 技能库：读核心 ctx.skills 注册表（模型实际加载的同一份目录），可搜索、按来源过滤、读 SKILL.md 全文。④ 文档：把 md/tex 源与 docx/pdf 产物按主干配对，把「产物比源旧」排最前。⑤ 左侧栏图标带「待我审」角标（还有几轮没审），零运行时依赖。
items.descriptionEn: A Workbench panel for DSH Web that turns "AI edits Markdown, regenerates Word/PDF/Excel, you review that build" into one visible timeline for a project; it docks in the main area, or in the right sidebar next to the conversation, which stays in the middle so both can be read side by side. (1) Iteration (default): grouped by production line and by day within a line, one row per build showing time, artifact kind, what that build did, which Markdown sources it came from and your approval state; hovering a row opens a summary card with the summary, time and size, generating command, changed sources, snapshot path and your earlier notes; clicking a build offers Approve / Needs-work / Reset, appended to .versions/decisions.jsonl. The timeline is not guessed: it reads .versions/produced.jsonl from each production-line directory, written by the producer at generation time; artifacts that exist on disk but have no record are listed (unrecorded), and one note is enough to adopt one as a build — the plugin copies a snapshot into .versions/ and appends a record, recovering the generating command from the DSH session log. From a build you can open that snapshot, open the current working copy, or reveal it in the file manager. (2) Compare with the previous build: the two bodies of text side by side with a paragraph-level diff (additions green, deletions red) and word-level highlighting inside matched change pairs; for the Excel family each row is one block and only the changed cell is marked, through the same diff as Word. (3) Skill Library reads the core ctx.skills registry (the same catalog the model loads), with search, source filter and full SKILL.md text. (4) Documents pairs Markdown/LaTeX sources with their docx/pdf artifacts by stem and floats stale artifacts to the top. (5) The sidebar icon carries a pending-review badge. Zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: PPT 工作室
items.author: zbsph
items.description: 把做 PPT 变成带门禁的工程流程：四类任务工作流（从头 / 补完 / 修改 / 总结）+ 21 个 ppt_* 工具（建工程、渲染、数字审阅、视觉截图、导出、导入、只改一页）+ PPTD 中间层（deck.yaml + pages/*.yaml，1px = 1pt）+ 设计意图声明制（有意重叠逐对声明，内容互压永远拦下）+ 内置模板库与 Office 真渲染抽检；改既有 PPT 的某一页走 splice（其余页逐字节不变），单页交付走 slice，贴模板走 patch；另附四本内置技能手册（叙事版式 / 图表数据 / 中文文案 / 答疑）与「PPT 工作室」agent 预设。默认一条命令 `dsh plugin add <仓库 URL>` 装成 profile bundle——该 profile 的所有会话都能用这些工具与手册；若想让它们**只在选中「PPT 工作室」预设的会话里出现**，在解压后的发布包里跑 `node scripts/install.mjs --isolate` 即可切到会话级隔离（两条路互斥，各一句命令来回切，详见仓库 README §0.7）。
items.descriptionEn: Turns deck making into a gated engineering workflow: a four-task pipeline (from scratch / augment / edit / summarize), 21 ppt_* tools (scaffold, render, numeric review, screenshots, export, import, single-page edit), the PPTD intermediate layer (deck.yaml + pages/*.yaml, 1px = 1pt), design-intent declarations (intentional overlaps are declared pair by pair, content collisions are always blocked), a built-in template library and Office real-render spot checks. Editing one page of an existing deck goes through splice (every other page stays byte-identical), single-page delivery through slice and template patching through patch, plus four bundled skill manuals (narrative and layout, charts and data, Chinese copy, Q&A) and a PPT Studio agent preset. Install with a single command (`dsh plugin add <repo URL>`) as a profile bundle, which makes the tools and manuals available to every session in that profile; to scope them to sessions that select the "PPT Studio" preset instead, run `node scripts/install.mjs --isolate` from the unpacked release (the two mount paths are mutually exclusive and switch with one command each; see README section 0.7).

items.descriptionEn: Vendor parameter translation and deterministic JSON repair: /translate maps temperature, top_p, max_tokens, stop and system across eleven vendors, and the post-execute layer repairs broken JSON output.

items.name: mcptoon MCP 接入
items.author: activeing123
items.description: 把 mcptoon 作为一条 stdio MCP 服务接入，让 agent 通过 mcptoon 的压缩视图发现已配置 MCP server 的工具，而非每轮支付完整 JSON schema。附带 doctor CLI：校验 mcptoon 可执行文件能否解析，不能时打印精确的 command/args 覆盖配置。
items.descriptionEn: Mounts the mcptoon MCP bridge as one stdio server, so the agent discovers the tools of every MCP server you have configured through mcptoon's compressed view instead of full JSON schemas on each turn. Ships a doctor CLI that checks the mcptoon executable resolves and prints the exact command/args override when it does not.

items.name: Claude Code 桌面主题
items.author: Nwflower
items.description: 为 DSH Web GUI 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的视觉与交互：象牙白/暖黑双画布与陶烬橙强调色、衬线/无衬线/等宽三字体分工、权限分段控件、品牌切换与模型选择器文案，纯 CSS 覆盖加客户端 DOM override 实现。
items.descriptionEn: Recreates the Claude Code Desktop look and interaction model for the DSH Web GUI: ivory/warm-black dual canvas with a single clay accent, serif/sans/mono three-font system, permission segmented control, brand switcher and model-picker copy — pure CSS overrides plus client-side DOM overrides.

items.name: 会话挂起提醒
items.author: Archaofan
items.description: 在对话里用一句自然语言挂起当前会话：侧边栏对应行按样式预设高亮，悬停弹出提醒卡片；折叠的工作区显示其中的挂起数量，挂起总览按预设样式区分。
items.descriptionEn: Park the current session with one natural-language note: the matching sidebar row is highlighted by style preset with a hover reminder card, a folded workspace shows how many of its sessions are parked, and the parked overview is differentiated by preset.

items.name: 本地长期记忆
items.author: tr1v3r
items.description: 基于本地 SQLite 的结构化长期记忆：CJK 感知检索、BM25 与字符 n-gram 余弦相似度混合重排，支持去重、更新、合并、确认与过期复核，以及全局和项目作用域；通过 agent 工具与 CLI 共用同一存储引擎，无需云端服务或 embedding 依赖。
items.descriptionEn: Structured long-term memory in local SQLite: CJK-aware search with hybrid BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, updates, merging, confirmation and staleness review, plus global and project scopes. Agent tools and a CLI share one storage engine, with no cloud service or embedding dependency required.

items.name: 上下文健康
items.author: donghangxunlang-cmd
items.description: 上下文健康监测 + 内容退化检测（思考打转、输出复读）+ 继续 vs 交接成本裁决 + 零模型交接文档。纯本地、零网络。
items.descriptionEn: Context health monitoring, content-degradation detection (thinking loops / output repetition), a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict, and zero-model handoff documents. Local-only, no network.

items.name: 微信接入 DSH
items.author: zhy5
items.description: 把手机微信接到本机 DSH：自建 iLink 桥 + 常驻 ACP 原生会话（上下文由 DSH 持有、可 resume），手机对话就是桌面工作区里的会话；支持图片识别、直接发文件（Excel / Word / PDF 等，由会话里的 agent 自行解析）与语音转写，带「微信连接」设置面板。准入默认 strict（只服务已登记设备）；权限预设默认 workspace-write，越界的写与提权会先在微信里弹审批卡、可直接在微信内应答，120 秒未应答按拒绝；danger-full-access 现在是需要手动开启的选项。
items.descriptionEn: Bridge WeChat to your local DSH: a self-hosted iLink bridge over a persistent ACP session (context lives in DSH and stays resumable). Phone conversations appear as desktop workspace sessions, with image recognition, file messages (Excel/Word/PDF, parsed by the agent itself) and voice transcripts, plus a settings panel. Access defaults to strict (only registered devices are served); the permission preset defaults to workspace-write, with out-of-workspace writes and privilege escalation surfaced as approvals answerable from WeChat (unanswered after 120s is denied); danger-full-access is now an opt-in.

items.name: Agent-Body 器官化插件层
items.author: 1420079678-ctrl
items.description: 把 DSH 插件组织成一具身体：插件声明自己是器官（能力 / 感知 / 反射弧），内核补上其余生理机能——按内环境变速的心脏泵血、神经冲动路由、零模型调用的反射弧、静默 2 分钟浅睡 5 分钟深睡的确定性记忆巩固，以及先归因再处置、器官下次成功才闭合伤口的自愈闭环；另含零驻留上下文引擎，把体积大的工具输出驱逐出活动上下文、只留指针，需要时按原样取回。一条命令装齐三个核心器官，其余器官可单独安装。
items.descriptionEn: Organises DSH plugins into a body: the plugins declare themselves organs (capabilities, senses, reflex arcs) and the kernel supplies the rest of the physiology — a heartbeat that changes rate with the internal environment, nerve-impulse routing, reflex arcs that fire with zero model calls, deterministic memory consolidation after 2 minutes of light and 5 minutes of deep sleep, and a self-healing loop that attributes a failure before acting and only closes a wound once the organ succeeds again. It also carries a zero-residence context engine that evicts oversized tool payloads from the live context, keeps pointers, and rebuilds any payload verbatim on demand. One command installs the three core organs; the others install individually.

items.name: 模型顺序
items.author: mengge237
items.description: 自定义模型 / 提供方的排列顺序：在「设置 → 模型」里你自己配置的提供方卡片内拖拽调整（宿主内置的 DeepSeek 卡片里这块是只读清单），宿主的模型列表按这份顺序返回（稳定排序，只重排，不增删条目、不改字段）。顺序写回当前生效的配置真源，写前自动备份，并校验条目集合未增删、总行数不变、块外逐行一致、重读顺序达标 —— 任一道不过就整次拒绝，一个字节都不写。0.1.5 线写 settings.yaml，0.1.7 线起写 profile 用户层的 cordis.patch.yml，两代形状都认。
items.descriptionEn: Custom provider and model ordering: drag to reorder inside the provider cards you configured yourself on the Models settings page (the built-in DeepSeek card renders as a read-only list), and the host model list follows that order (stable sort - reordering only, never adding, dropping or rewriting entries). The order is written back to whichever config source is live, with an automatic backup plus checks that the id set is unchanged, the line count is unchanged, every line outside the block is byte-identical and the order reads back correct; if any check fails the whole write is refused and nothing is touched. Writes settings.yaml on the 0.1.5 line and the profile user layer cordis.patch.yml from 0.1.7 on - both shapes are parsed.

items.name: 550C 开机动画
items.author: yannicksong0106
items.description: 给 DSH 加一段 550C 全屏开机片头：简易档 4 秒、完整档 16 秒覆写流程，点击或按 Esc 跳过，四套磷光配色。首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸；桌面窗口右上角那条原生按钮条带在片头期间透明化，按钮像浮在动画上。
items.descriptionEn: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.

items.name: 组件栏
items.author: Physicolor
items.description: 会话右侧的多列组件栏：55 个内置单元覆盖会话（轮次·步数、上下文水位、token 与缓存命中率、首 token 延迟、工具调用、后台任务、子代理）、额度（OpenCode Go 与 Command Code 的滚动/周/月窗口、余额、月末外推与今日推荐）、机器（CPU / GPU / 内存 / 磁盘 / 网络 / 供电，含迷你折线与环形图，另有本地服务与代理出口看板）与 GitHub（待审队列、提交、Issue）。每个单元独立安装，2×2 或 2×4，悬浮时沿组件栏形成连续放大波；设置页可安装、排序、改尺寸与逐实例配置。
items.descriptionEn: A multi-column widget rail on the right of the session: 55 built-in units for the session (turns and steps, context level, tokens and cache-hit rate, first-token latency, tool calls, background jobs, subagents), quota (OpenCode Go and Command Code rolling / weekly / monthly windows, balances, month-end projection and today's budget), the machine (CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network and power with sparklines and rings, plus a local-service and proxy-egress board) and GitHub (review queue, pushes, issues). Every unit installs on its own at 2x2 or 2x4, a continuous magnification wave follows the pointer along the rail, and the settings page installs, reorders, resizes and configures each instance.

items.name: 网文写作工作台
items.author: siweina
items.description: 给中文网文作者的本地写作工作台：动笔前一次调用取齐上一章承接口、本章大纲、人物卡、待回收伏笔与用语规范；写完按六维文笔基线与原著波动带量化自检，诊断结果排成带原句行号的改稿待办；跨章可查伏笔埋设跨度、人物连续缺席与大纲偏离。句式、情感与语义全部用随包分发的 24MB 中文模型在本机推理，零 API 花费、正文不出本机；18 个工具，同一套能力也可作为 MCP 服务器给 Claude Desktop / Cursor 使用。
items.descriptionEn: A local workbench for Chinese web-novel writers: one call before drafting gathers the previous chapter's hand-off, the current outline, related character cards, unresolved plot threads and the world's language rules; after drafting, a six-dimension prose baseline derived from the source drives a quantified self-check that becomes a prioritised revision plan with original line numbers; across chapters it reports plot-thread spans, characters missing for too long and outline drift. Sentence, emotion and semantic analysis all run on a bundled 24MB Chinese model on-device — zero API cost, the manuscript never leaves the machine; 18 tools, and the same capabilities ship as an MCP server for Claude Desktop / Cursor.

items.name: 录屏与截图
items.author: Link-h1j
items.description: 把「说不清」的界面问题变成能直接发给模型的视频 / 图片证据，减少人机沟通的来回损耗：在输入框工具条的「听写」左边加「录屏」「截图」两个按钮。截图：弹出选区浮层（拖动框选 / 单击整屏 / Enter 确认 / Esc 取消），选中的画面直接进附件，拖完框选手一松就能用画笔 / 矩形 / 箭头 / 文字标注，只在选区内生效。录屏：点一下先选「录哪一个」（整个桌面 / 某台显示器 / 某个窗口——跟着窗口移动改大小 / 自定义区域拖框，都带缩略图），再点一下结束（Esc 亦可），产出一个 .webm 视频并自动进附件；抽帧交给会话里的 agent 做。抓屏在宿主进程完成 —— 桌面壳禁用了 getDisplayMedia，浏览器端拿不到流。录屏需要本机 Python 3 + Pillow 与一个带 libvpx 的 ffmpeg（起录前会做能力预检，缺什么会直接说清怎么补，可用 DSH_CAPTURE_PYTHON / DSH_CAPTURE_FFMPEG 指定路径）；截图只需要 PowerShell。仅支持 Windows。
items.descriptionEn: Turns a hard-to-describe UI problem into footage the model can actually look at, cutting the back-and-forth of human-agent communication: adds Record and Capture buttons to the composer toolbar, left of the dictation button. Capture opens a region overlay (drag to select, click for full screen, Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel) and attaches the selection to the message; the annotation toolbar (pen / rectangle / arrow / text) shows up the moment you release the drag and only paints inside the selection. Record first asks what to record (whole desktop / a monitor / a window that is followed as it moves or resizes / a custom region, each with a thumbnail), then stops on a second click (Esc also stops) and produces a single .webm attached to the message; frame extraction is left to the agent in the session. Screen grabbing runs in the host process because the desktop shell disables getDisplayMedia, so the renderer can never obtain a stream. Recording needs a local Python 3 with Pillow plus an ffmpeg built with libvpx; both are probed before recording starts and the error names exactly what to install, and DSH_CAPTURE_PYTHON / DSH_CAPTURE_FFMPEG can point at them explicitly. Capture needs only PowerShell. Windows only.

items.name: AI Studio
items.author: DDDMUC
items.description: 把一轮对话变成可以反复打磨的 prompt playground：就地改一句提示词并回滚重问、对某条回复原位重跑、把不该留下的一轮从模型上下文删掉、并让发出的提示词按 Markdown 渲染。自包含安装，一个包内置全部四个组件（编辑并重跑、原位重跑、删除该轮、Markdown 气泡），插件列表里只显示 AI Studio 一行；四个组件仍是各自独立的 npm 包，单独安装时各自出现在列表里。设置 > 插件 > AI Studio 面板如实报告每个组件的实际状态（已安装 / 已挂载 / 版本）。
items.descriptionEn: Turn one turn into a prompt playground you can keep revising: rewrite a prompt in place and roll the conversation back to just before it, regenerate a reply from the same prompt while later turns survive, remove a turn from the model context, and render sent prompts as Markdown. Self-contained - one package bundles all four components (edit and re-run, re-run in place, delete this turn, Markdown bubble) and the plugin list shows a single AI Studio row; each component is still its own independent npm package and appears as its own row when installed standalone. The Settings > Plugins > AI Studio panel reports what each component is actually doing (installed / mounted / version).

items.name: 壁纸引擎
items.author: elysia395
items.description: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸渲染到 DSH 聊天界面后方：Scene/Web 由内置 WebWallGL 实时渲染，Video 直接播放；附液态玻璃、壁纸属性面板、Now Playing 联动与主题随壁纸。与皮肤类插件互斥（二选一）。
items.descriptionEn: Renders local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the DSH chat UI: Scene/Web via the bundled WebWallGL renderer, Video plays directly, with liquid glass, a wallpaper properties panel, Now Playing integration and theme following. Mutually exclusive with skin plugins (choose one).

items.name: 宠物额度气泡
items.author: Daizhdd
items.description: 在 DSH 桌面宠物头上显示今日 token 用量：按输入+缓存读+缓存写+输出与侧边栏同口径统计，分轻度/中度/重度三档，档位只用一个彩色圆点表示，无进度条与百分比；另有任务完成、本轮失败、跨档三类事件气泡，全部通过宠物插件公开的 announce 接口推送，不改动任何第三方代码。
items.descriptionEn: Shows today token usage as a bubble above the DSH desktop pet: counts input + cache-read + cache-write + output with the same convention as the sidebar, sorts the day into three tiers shown as a single coloured dot (no progress bar, no percentage), and adds completion / failure / tier-change bubbles through the pet plugin public announce API without patching any third-party code.

items.name: dsh-breadboard
items.author: Noob-stupid
items.description: DSH 嵌入式硬件沙盒插件：在 3D 面包板场景里摆放 ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED 等器件、按协议与电压校验接线，再让真实 Python 项目代码在环运行、经 Python shim 读虚拟 I2C/GPIO 的寄存器级读数；支持故障注入（断线 / NACK / busy / 强制读数）验证异常处理。另有第二类虚拟硬件——联网设备，主动向真实 HTTP 后端周期上报（已在真实智能选座系统全链路验证）。随插件带 13 个 hw_* 工具与一份 SKILL.md。
items.descriptionEn: A DSH embedded hardware sandbox plugin: place ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED components on a 3D breadboard scene, wire ports with protocol and voltage checks, then run real Python project code in the loop, reading register-level virtual I2C/GPIO readings through a Python shim; fault injection (disconnect, NACK, busy, forced readings) validates exception handling. A second class of virtual hardware — networked devices — reports periodically over HTTP to a real backend (validated full-chain against a live seat-reservation system). Ships 13 hw_* agent tools and a bundled SKILL.md.

items.name: 地址栏深链
items.author: DDDMUC
items.description: 给 DSH Web 的每个界面一个自己的链接：会话、面板、设置（小节与页签）、会话内视图、轨迹行、轮次、右栏 pane 都写进地址栏。侧边栏会话行变成真链接，浏览器原生的右键菜单、中键与 Cmd 点击都能用；点击某一行或某一轮只把位置反映进地址栏，不拦截点击、不碰交互元素。粘贴链接会打开对应界面，轮次链接还会先把历史翻页回那一轮、再滚到它。检测到别的插件写的 fragment 时只报告一次且绝不覆盖；路由健康报告见 window.__dshUrlRouter.report()。只写 fragment、只用 replaceState，任何一步都不抛异常。
items.descriptionEn: Give every surface of the DSH Web GUI its own link: conversations, panels, settings (section and tab), conversation views, trajectory rows, turns and right-bar panes all land in the address bar. Sidebar conversation rows become real anchors, so the native context menu, middle-click and Cmd-click keep working; clicking a row or a turn only reflects the position and never intercepts the click or touches interactive elements. Pasting a link opens that surface, and a turn link pages history back to the turn before scrolling to it. A fragment written by another plugin is reported once and never overwritten, and window.__dshUrlRouter.report() exposes a route health report. Fragment-only writes through replaceState, and no step throws.

items.name: DSH Flash 精简预设
items.author: LarryE135
items.description: 面向 flash 级路由的两个 token 效率优化 agent 预设：flash-lean-ptc-v2（现行推荐）与 flash-lean-ptc-v1。PTC 工具面（run_code 为唯一直接可调用工具）加行为硬约束，压缩阈值等参数写在补丁层；以 DSH 组合包（dsh.bundle）形式随 profile 一键安装，README 附 BENCH-STD 基准数据（8 用例同批对照）与 scripts/selftest.sh 端到端自测。宿主侧纯配置补丁，无浏览器半区。
items.descriptionEn: Two token-efficiency agent presets for flash-tier routes: flash-lean-ptc-v2 (the current recommendation) and flash-lean-ptc-v1. A PTC tool surface (run_code is the only directly callable tool) plus hard behavior rules, with the compaction parameters set in the patch layer; installed into a profile as a DSH bundle (dsh.bundle). The README carries the BENCH-STD benchmark data (8 cases, same-batch comparison) and scripts/selftest.sh runs the end-to-end self-test. Host-side configuration patch only, with no browser half.

items.name: 连接卡片宿主
items.author: Noob-stupid
items.description: 把「连接」做成 DSH 里的一等对象：会话是节点，连接是容器，卡片按连接挂载。一条连接连接两个会话，两端可以互相读取对方的工作状态、共用一份记录接口与分工的「公约盒」，并按四档紧急度互发消息；权限分方向（只读／建议／写入），两个方向互不影响。卡片是挂在连接上的连接级插件：卡片注册的工具只有这条连接上的会话能通过一个常驻桥接工具调用，可见范围可以按端限定；卡片自带依赖、装在独立目录，不写入 DSH profile。连接、权限与已安装卡片都保存在 $DSH_HOME/connection-cards/ 下，重启后连接会恢复。
items.descriptionEn: Makes a connection a first-class object in DSH: sessions are nodes, a connection is the container, and cards mount per connection. One connection joins two sessions, so each side can read the other's work state, share a convention box for interfaces and ownership, and send messages at four urgency levels; permissions are per direction (read-only / suggest / write) and the two directions are independent. Cards are connection-level plugins: the tools a card registers are reachable only by sessions on that connection, through one resident bridge tool, with visibility scoped per side; a card carries its own dependencies in its own directory and writes nothing to the DSH profile. Connections, permissions and installed cards live under $DSH_HOME/connection-cards/, and connections are restored on restart.

items.name: TRAE CN 反代与控制台
items.author: FuSheng-cs
items.description: TRAE CN 反代与内嵌控制台，支持自动签到、多账号管理和轮询、模型发现、思考档位及模型显示/隐藏。自动签到与轮询默认关闭；仅限有权使用且服务方允许的账号与功能，详见仓库免责声明。
items.descriptionEn: TRAE CN relay and embedded console with daily check-in, multiple accounts, rotation, model discovery, reasoning levels and visibility controls. Automation is off by default; account/service permission is required. See the repository disclaimer.

items.name: dsh web start ui · 启动动画
items.author: stushansusu
items.description: 打开 DSH 时的全屏启动动画（视频皮肤）：宿主半区在界面首绘之前就把视频起播，浏览器半区接管同一个 <video>（不重播），视频播完才落帘。包内自带一段皮肤（青花瓷 · 水墨，12.3s），设置页可选皮肤、上传与删除自定义皮肤（存 $DSH_HOME/launch-animations）、即时预览、播放频率与点击跳过；资产路由带 ETag 与 Range，二次启动走 304 不再重下。独立插件，不并入全家桶。
items.descriptionEn: A full-screen launch video for DSH: the host half starts the video before the shell paints, the browser half adopts that very <video> element instead of restarting it, and the curtain lifts when the video ends. One skin ships in the package (Blue-and-White · Ink, 12.3s); the settings page selects skins, uploads and deletes custom ones (kept in $DSH_HOME/launch-animations), previews on the spot, and controls replay policy and click-to-skip. Asset responses carry an ETag (a cached install revalidates with a 304) and support Range requests. Standalone plugin, not enrolled in the all-in-one bundle.

items.name: 侧边栏工作区运行标记
items.author: charliesbyte
items.description: 在侧边栏的工作区行上显示其下会话的运行状态：有会话运行时显示与产品状态点同几何的转圈，全部停止后短暂保留一个已完成圆点，折叠时把文件夹图标染成产品「所在分组」的蓝色。只贡献一张样式表，不替换侧边栏组件。
items.descriptionEn: Shows activity on each sidebar workspace row: a spinner drawn with the product's own status-dot geometry while any of its sessions are running, a short-lived finished dot after they all stop, and the product's blue folder tint while collapsed. Contributes one stylesheet and never replaces the sidebar.

items.name: DSH Token 用量统计
items.author: xgxx666
items.description: 本地会话历史用量面板，与 dsh-usage-panel 有部分功能重叠。本插件侧重 DSH 原生缓存命中口径、今天的小时活动与 Token 构成，并保留原版输入框状态栏和详情弹窗；还支持日历热力图、本地/API 筛选，不估算费用。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高兼容版本。
items.descriptionEn: Local historical usage in DSH Settings, with some overlap with dsh-usage-panel. This plugin focuses on DSH-native cache-hit accounting, today's hourly activity and token composition, while leaving the built-in composer status and details intact. It also has a calendar heatmap and local/API filters; no cost estimates. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.

items.name: 技能安装
items.author: Joey-K-tsubame
items.description: 从 GitHub 仓库搜索并安装 SKILL.md 技能：装到全局 / 当前项目 / 自定义目录，与内置 skill-filesystem 联动，装完即时生效；安装会把第三方仓库的 SKILL.md 原样写入技能根目录，只装信任的仓库。
items.descriptionEn: Search GitHub repositories and install their SKILL.md skills into the global, project, or a custom directory; hot-loads through the built-in skill-filesystem; installation copies a third-party repository's SKILL.md verbatim into a skills root — only install repositories you trust.

items.name: 删除已归档对话
items.author: Joey-K-tsubame
items.description: 为已归档会话在侧边栏增加「删除对话」入口，并提供模型可调用的 delete_archived_conversation 工具：该工具无二次确认即可执行、删除不可恢复。清单与删除能力与 dsh-archived-chats 重叠，增量就是这两个入口；与 dsh-delete-session 的区别是本插件只处理已归档会话，侧边栏走两步确认，而工具调用没有确认。
items.descriptionEn: Adds a sidebar delete entry for archived conversations plus the model-callable delete_archived_conversation tool, which runs without a second confirmation and is irreversible. Listing and removal overlap dsh-archived-chats - the increment is those two entry points; unlike dsh-delete-session it only touches archived sessions, with a two-step confirm in the sidebar and no confirmation for the tool call.

items.name: 硬件监视
items.author: JoblessJoe
items.description: btop 风格的实时硬件监视：会话标题栏中的 CPU / GPU 迷你小组件（点击打开完整视图），以及 Chat / Trajectory 旁边的 Hardware 标签页：CPU 总负载、60 秒走势和每核负载、内存、CPU 温度，以及每块 NVIDIA GPU 的温度、负载、功耗和显存（通过 nvidia-smi）。已在 Linux 上实测；macOS 和 Windows 的读取逻辑目前仅用样例输出测试过。每项信号使用系统提供的免特权数据源，没有时自动隐藏。零运行时依赖，无需配置。
items.descriptionEn: Live btop-style hardware monitor: a CPU / GPU mini widget in the session header (click opens the full view) and a Hardware tab next to Chat / Trajectory with overall CPU load, a 60 s sparkline and per-core load, memory, CPU temperature, and per NVIDIA GPU temperature, load, power draw and VRAM (via nvidia-smi). Tested live on Linux; the macOS and Windows readers are only checked against sample output so far. Each signal uses an unprivileged OS source and hides itself when there is none. Zero runtime dependencies, no config.

items.name: 流式折叠
items.author: rezon-aki
items.description: 在官方对话流上做展示增强：运行中自动展开最新的思考小窗、旧过程行折成一条摘要；一轮跑完把思考与工具调用折起，穿插正文保留。折叠按 3 行一组错峰、逐帧推进，不依赖历史是否加载完；折叠内容保持可搜索（hidden=until-found），Ctrl+F 仍能命中；跑完平滑回到你那一问。启用「折叠」档会接管官方「对话显示」设置：把官方 transcriptView 写成 verbose 并隐藏官方那一行；从本插件切回官方档会写回所选档，卸载后官方档停在「完全展开」，需要时到官方设置里改回。
items.descriptionEn: A display enhancement over the official transcript: while a turn runs, the newest thinking window opens itself and older process rows fold into one summary; at the end of a turn, thinking and tool calls fold away while interleaved prose stays. Folding advances per frame without waiting for history to load, folded rows stay searchable (hidden=until-found) so Ctrl+F still finds them, and a finished turn scrolls back to your question. While its Fold mode is active it takes over the official transcript display setting: the official transcriptView is parked on Verbose and that row is hidden. Switching back to an official mode from this plugin writes the chosen mode back; uninstalling leaves the official value on Verbose until it is changed in the official settings.

items.name: 日志查询
items.author: hyzyn
items.description: Elasticsearch / OpenSearch 的日志查询卡片：一个查询面——按来源方言给查询串与可点例子、字段名补全、筛选芯片、可点柱缩放时间窗的时间分布、把分组的桶点成筛选、带级别染色与堆栈续行标记的结果列表（可选列、可翻页）；Docker 容器日志作为采集来源复用 docker 插件。agent 侧五个只读 loglens_* 工具（sources / search / fields / facets / context）与面板共用同一执行层。出站只打到已配置的来源，按解析后的 IP 判定，不跟随重定向，并有体积与超时上限。
items.descriptionEn: A log query card over Elasticsearch / OpenSearch: one query surface with per-dialect query strings and clickable examples, field-name completion, filter chips, a time histogram whose bars zoom into that window, field facets that turn a bucket into a filter, and a result list with level colors, stack-continuation rows, columns and paging; Docker container logs are a collection source that reuses the docker plugin. Ships five read-only loglens_* tools (sources / search / fields / facets / context) sharing the same execution layer as the panel. Outbound requests only reach configured sources, judged on the resolved IP, without following redirects and with size and timeout caps.

items.name: 断点续跑按钮
items.author: ddy-007
items.description: 在输入框加一个「继续」按钮：上一轮被用户中止、崩溃或报错结束后，输入框为空时按钮出现，点一下就发出一条续跑提示，让模型接着把那一轮做完。按钮位于模型选择器左侧，开始输入或添加附件时收窄隐藏，清空后展开回来。不恢复中断时的半截输出——那部分内容从未落盘，插件是新开一轮 turn 重做。
items.descriptionEn: Adds a Continue button to the composer: after a turn ends aborted (user pressed stop), interrupted (crash) or errored, the button appears while the composer is empty, and one click sends a continuation notice so the model picks that turn back up. It sits left of the model selector and collapses while you type or attach a file. It does not restore the interrupted output - that partial content was never persisted, so the plugin starts a new turn instead.

items.name: DSH 版本守卫
items.author: skyjjgw
items.description: 记录插件版本与 profile 配置快照；插件冲突导致 DSH 无法启动时，通过独立恢复页回退到已知可用配置。支持单插件停用、恢复启用、版本锁定和显式依赖同步，不回退 DSH 应用本身。
items.descriptionEn: Snapshots plugin versions and profile configuration. An independent recovery page restores a known-good configuration when plugin conflicts prevent DSH from starting. Supports disabling and re-enabling plugins, version pinning, and explicit dependency synchronization; it does not roll back the DSH application.

items.name: MiniMax Code 模型接入
items.author: JeffTsuiCUG
items.description: 把本机 MiniMax Code 桌面 App（国内版）的模型接入 DSH，零配置、无需 API Key。前置：本机已安装并登录 MiniMax Code 桌面 App（国内版）——否则模型列表只回落为两个内置占位条目、实际调不通；也可不装桌面 App，在插件页面发起 OAuth 设备码登录，在浏览器里用自己的 MiniMax 账号确认。上游是标准 Anthropic Messages 协议，直接复用 DSH 自带的 provider，工具调用、推理块与上下文压缩由 DSH 托管；模型目录从上游实时拉取，模型增减不需要更新插件。界面在输入框工具行（模型选择器旁）显示一枚余额胶囊，仅在选中本插件的模型时出现（切到其他反代插件的模型即隐藏）；插件页面另有余额卡片、本机消耗折算的等效金额、7 天内/30 天内到期的积分批次与每日签到。凭据写入：为续期已过期的桌面 App 登录态，插件会按该 App 自己的格式原子写回其 auth 文件（不改 generation）；用插件自己登录的，凭据只写插件自己的 ~/.dsh/.minimaxcode-auth.json，不碰 App 目录。非官方插件，与 MiniMax、DeepSeek 均无关联；依赖 MiniMax 客户端的非公开接口，客户端更新后接口可能变更导致失效；仅供学习与研究使用。
items.descriptionEn: Brings the models of the MiniMax Code desktop app (China region) into DSH, zero configuration, no API key. Prerequisite: the MiniMax Code desktop app (China region) installed and signed in on this machine — without a sign-in the model list falls back to two built-in placeholders that cannot actually be called; or skip the app entirely, since the plugin page offers an OAuth device-code sign-in you confirm with your own MiniMax account in a browser. The upstream speaks the standard Anthropic Messages protocol, so DSH's own provider is reused and tool calls, reasoning blocks and context compaction stay Harness-owned; the model catalog is pulled live, so upstream model changes need no plugin update. The interface shows a balance pill in the composer tool row beside the model picker, drawn only while this plugin's models are selected (it hides when another connector's model is selected); the plugin page adds a balance card, this machine's consumption converted to an equivalent cost, the credit batches expiring within 7 and 30 days, and the daily check-in. Credential writes: to renew an expired desktop-app sign-in the plugin writes the app's auth file back atomically, in the app's own format, without changing its generation counter; when signed in through the plugin itself the credential is stored only in the plugin's own ~/.dsh/.minimaxcode-auth.json, never in the app's directory. Unofficial plugin, not affiliated with MiniMax or DeepSeek; it depends on the MiniMax client's non-public interfaces, which a client update may change and break. For learning and research only.
